programme.title: Dragon Sword-Ancient Battlefield / 禦龍修仙傳3上古戰場
programme.desc: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

programme.title: White Haired Witch / 白髮魔女外傳
programme.desc: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

programme.title: Mutation On Mars / 火星異變
programme.desc: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

programme.title: Guan Shan Tai Bao / 牧野詭事之觀山太保
programme.desc: To raise funds for their troops, Master Feng agress to help Zheng Dong Xi find corpses within an ancient tomb. Zheng's true motive is to uncover the tomb's hidden treasure and he also enlist the help of Chen. Together, they embark on a perilous expedition to hunt for the treasure as well as to help the people.

programme.title: Almost Human / 機械畫皮
programme.desc: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

programme.title: Crazy Old Father / 瘋狂老爹
programme.desc: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

programme.title: Lost in Apocalypse / 末世人間道
programme.desc: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

programme.title: Private Hero / 私人英雄
programme.desc: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

programme.title: Apolar Battlefield / 張三豐2太極天師
programme.desc: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. programme.title: Zombie Chickadee / 殭屍山雀
programme.desc: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. programme.title: Wolf Killing Action / 滅狼行動
programme.desc: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. programme.title: Mohist Mechanism / 墨家機關術
programme.desc: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his father's death caused by Ru's father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

programme.title: Dragon Sword-Ancient Battlefield / 禦龍修仙傳3上古戰場
programme.desc: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

programme.title: White Haired Witch / 白髮魔女外傳
programme.desc: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

programme.title: Mutation On Mars / 火星異變
programme.desc: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

programme.title: Guan Shan Tai Bao / 牧野詭事之觀山太保
programme.desc: To raise funds for their troops, Master Feng agress to help Zheng Dong Xi find corpses within an ancient tomb. Zheng's true motive is to uncover the tomb's hidden treasure and he also enlist the help of Chen. Together, they embark on a perilous expedition to hunt for the treasure as well as to help the people.

programme.title: Almost Human / 機械畫皮
programme.desc: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

programme.title: Crazy Old Father / 瘋狂老爹
programme.desc: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

programme.title: Lost in Apocalypse / 末世人間道
programme.desc: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

programme.title: Private Hero / 私人英雄
programme.desc: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

programme.title: Apolar Battlefield / 張三豐2太極天師
programme.desc: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

programme.title: Zombie Chickadee / 殭屍山雀
programme.desc: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

programme.title: Wolf Killing Action / 滅狼行動
programme.desc: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs. A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Mohist Mechanism / 墨家機關術
programme.desc: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the city's labyrinth of mechanism.

programme.title: Fantasy Magician / 奇門遁甲
programme.desc: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by "magical astronomy" and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

programme.title: The Revenge of Plant / 花悸
programme.desc: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professor's secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

programme.title: The Legend and Hag of Shaolin / 洪熙官之魔門妖女
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong Xi Guan travels to Guangzhou with Fang Shi Yu to propagate Shaolin martial arts. Through exchanges with rival sect masters and imperial forces, Hong integrates Shaolin martial arts skills into other martial arts styles and established the "Hung Sect", which embodied the collective wisdom and beauty of the martial arts world.
